subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest set a fixed 1536 MiB Node heap cap by default, or should this PR be narrowed to optional operator guidance after correcting the Node/cgroup wording?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes a public deployment default and the right default depends on maintainer intent for Kubernetes operators, not just mechanical correctness.

options.title: Ship fixed cap after correction and proof
options.body: Keep the manifest env var, correct the cgroup explanation, and require redacted Kubernetes evidence that the reported pod no longer exits 137.

options.title: Make it optional guidance
options.body: Remove the manifest default and document an overlay or operator note for memory-constrained Kubernetes deployments.

options.title: Pause until stronger repro
options.body: Keep the PR open for more evidence, or close later if no reproducible Kubernetes OOM evidence arrives.

recommendation.title: Ship fixed cap after correction and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the manifest env var, correct the cgroup explanation, and require redacted Kubernetes evidence that the reported pod no longer exits 137.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Kubernetes install guide and manifests that define the operator-facing default being changed.
